words.tr:
v. 覆盖；叠加；铺；镀
n. 覆盖物；涂层
v. 躺在…上面；把（婴儿）覆闷致死；“overlie”的过去式
words.ex: He put an overlay on the photo to add text.
words.ex_cn: 他在照片上叠加了一层以添加文字。
words.en: To cover something with a layer of another material, or to lie on top of something else.

words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.ex: The toddler is walking slowly by the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 这个幼儿正慢慢地在沙发旁走路。
words.en: A toddler is a young child who has just learned to walk or who is learning to walk.

words.tr:
v. 安慰；慰问
n. 控制台；操纵台
words.ex: She whispered kind words to console her crying friend.
words.ex_cn: 她轻声说些安慰的话来安抚哭泣的朋友。
words.en: If you console someone who is unhappy about something, you try to make them feel more cheerful.

words.ex: People around the world love coffee.
words.ex_cn: 世界各地的人们都喜欢咖啡。
words.en: In or to many countries throughout the world.

words.tr: adj. 使人惊恐的；引起恐慌的； v. “alarm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news report showed an alarming rise in crimes.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道显示犯罪率令人惊恐地上升。
words.en: If something is alarming, it makes you feel afraid or anxious that something unpleasant or dangerous might happen.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: The otter swam quickly in the river.
words.ex_cn: 水獭在河里快速游动。
words.en: An otter is a furry aquatic mammal that is known for its playful behavior and ability to swim gracefully.

words.tr: adj. 有帮助的；乐器的；仪器的；
words.ex: Her advice was instrumental in helping me pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对帮助我通过考试很有帮助。
words.en: If someone or something is instrumental in a process, plan, or system, they are one of the most important influences in causing it to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 作出选择；做出抉择
words.ex: You need to make choice now.
words.ex_cn: 你现在需要做出选择。
words.en: To select or decide on a particular option from a range of possibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 依附于；连接到； attaching oneself or something to a person, object, or place
words.ex: The child attaches to his mother when he is scared.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子害怕时，他会依附于母亲。
words.en: To fasten, join, or connect something to something else.

words.ex: The software has five different modules.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有五个不同的模块。
words.en: A module is one of the separate parts of a course of study, especially at a college or university.

words.ex: Two plus two is equivalent to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: Having the same value, function, or meaning as something else.

words.tr: v. 象征；代表；用符号表示
words.ex: The dove symbolizes peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子象征和平。
words.en: If one thing symbolizes another, it is used or regarded as a symbol of it.

words.ex: His disposition is calm and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的性情平静而善良。
words.en: Someone's disposition is the way that they tend to behave or feel.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: He works hard to emulate his older brother.
words.ex_cn: 他努力赶上他的哥哥。
words.en: To emulate someone or something means to try to be like them or to do something in the same way that they do it.

words.ex: He turned the loft into a bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他把阁楼改成了卧室。
words.en: A loft is a room or space directly under the roof of a building, used for accommodation or storage.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.tr: phrase. 合作；组队；联手（通常指为了共同目标而与他人协作）
words.ex: They team up to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作完成这个项目。
words.en: To join together with someone in order to work on something as a team.

words.ex: There was a large influx of tourists during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天期间涌入了大量游客。
words.en: An influx of people or things is a large number of them arriving somewhere at the same time.

words.tr: adj. 液压的；流体的；利用液体压力的；
words.ex: The hydraulic brake system stops the car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 液压制动系统能快速让汽车停下。
words.en: Hydraulic refers to the operation of machinery or systems by the movement and force of liquid, especially water or oil.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.ex: The prisoner was kept in chains for years.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯被锁链锁住多年。
words.en: Physically restrained with chains, or metaphorically restricted or confined.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: The teacher uses an integrative approach to teach science.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用一种综合的方法来教授科学。
words.en: Combining or coordinating separate elements so as to provide a harmonious, interrelated whole.

words.ex: He sings and plays guitar simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边弹吉他。
words.en: If two or more things happen simultaneously, they happen at exactly the same time.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: They did a collaborative project in class.
words.ex_cn: 他们在课堂上做了一个合作项目。
words.en: A collaborative piece of work is done by two or more people or groups working together.

words.tr:
n. 时距；跨度；
v. 跨越；
words.ex: The span of his career was 40 years.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的时距是40年。
words.en: The extent or measure of space between two points or extremities, as of a bridge or a roof; the full extent, stretch, or reach of anything.

words.ex: His idleness made him late for work.
words.ex_cn: 他的懒惰让他上班迟到。
words.en: The state of being idle; inactivity.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: He had a consultation with the doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他与医生进行了一次咨询。
words.en: A consultation is a meeting which is held to discuss something. Consultation is discussion about something that is still being planned.

words.tr: phrase. 联合国（由多个国家组成的国际组织，旨在促进国际合作与世界和平）
words.ex: The United Nations is an international organization aimed at promoting cooperation in international law, security, economic development, social progress, and human rights.
words.ex_cn: 联合国是一个旨在促进国际法、安全、经济发展、社会进步和人权合作的国际组织。
words.en: An international organization founded in 1945 to promote peace, security, and cooperation among countries around the world.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: The biosphere includes all living things on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 生物圈包括地球上所有生物。
words.en: The biosphere is the part of the Earth's surface and atmosphere in which plants and animals can live.

words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.ex: The fish spawn in the river each spring.
words.ex_cn: 鱼每年春天在河里产卵。
words.en: To spawn means to produce or deposit eggs, especially in large quantities, as fish, frogs, etc. do. It can also mean to give rise to or generate something.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: The two countries are in conflict over the border.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家因边界问题处于冲突中。
words.en: A situation in which two or more parties are in disagreement or opposition.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr: phrase. 怀着……的希望；期望能够；以期
words.ex: He waited outside the house in the hope of seeing her.
words.ex_cn: 他在房子外面等着，希望能见到她。
words.en: with the desire or expectation that something will happen

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微不足道的
words.ex: The miniscule dot was hard to see with the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 那个极小的点用肉眼很难看到。
words.en: If you describe something as miniscule, you mean that it is very small.

words.ex: Her only foible was a tendency to talk too much.
words.ex_cn: 她唯一的缺点就是话太多。
words.en: A foible is a minor weakness or eccentricity in someone's character.

words.tr: phrase. 通过这种方式；借此
words.ex: By this means, we can solve the problem efficiently.
words.ex_cn: 通过这种方式，我们可以有效地解决问题。
words.en: By this means, we can achieve our goals more efficiently.

words.tr: n. 描绘；描述；描写；展现方式；
words.ex: The movie's portrayal of love is very touching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对爱情的描绘非常感人。
words.en: A portrayal of someone or something is a description or depiction of them in a particular way.

words.ex: He has asthma and cannot run fast.
words.ex_cn: 他有哮喘，不能跑快。
words.en: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing. It usually results from an allergic reaction or other forms of hypersensitivity.

words.ex: I will share the book with my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我会和我的朋友分享这本书。
words.en: To give a portion of something to someone else.

words.ex: The boundless sky made her feel free.
words.ex_cn: 无边无际的天空让她感到自由。
words.en: If you describe something as boundless, you mean that it has no limits or seems to be without limits.

words.tr: phrase. 现存的；存在的；仍然活着的
words.ex: The oldest tree in the world is still in existence.
words.ex_cn: 世界上最古老的树仍然存在。
words.en: Currently existing or being in the present state.

words.ex: The ion moves quickly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这个离子在水中快速移动。
words.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

words.ex: The court punished the man for rape.
words.ex_cn: 法院因强奸罪惩罚了那个男人。
words.en: Rape is the crime of forcing someone to have sex with you, especially by using violence.

words.ex: The lake is a popular spot for observing waterfowl.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖是观察水禽的热门地点。
words.en: Waterfowl are birds that live on or around water, such as ducks, geese, and swans.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: His ethnicity is Chinese.
words.ex_cn: 他的种族渊源是中国。
words.en: Ethnicity is the fact or state of belonging to a social group that has a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: The interplay between light and shadow creates beauty.
words.ex_cn: 光与影的相互作用创造了美。
words.en: The way in which two or more things have an effect on each other.

words.ex: He tries to invert the numbers to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他试图将数字倒过来以找到答案。
words.en: To invert something means to turn it upside down or to reverse its position, order, or relationship.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: It was not until midnight that he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 直到午夜他才完成他的作业。
words.en: used to say that something did not happen before a particular time or event

words.tr: phrase. （航天器、火箭等）起飞；升空；发射
words.ex: The rocket will lift off at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 火箭将在上午9点起飞。
words.en: To lift off means to rise into the air or space from the ground, especially referring to aircraft or spacecraft.

words.tr: v. 预想；事先想好；预先形成
words.ex: He preconceives that all teachers are strict.
words.ex_cn: 他先入为主地认为所有老师都很严格。
words.en: To form an opinion or idea about something before having enough information or experience.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.tr: adj. 地质学的；地质上的；
words.ex: The geological layers show the history of the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这些地质层展示了地球的历史。
words.en: Relating to the study of the Earth's physical structure and substance, its history, and the processes that act on it.

words.ex: He succeeded as the result of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他由于努力工作而成功。
words.en: because of something that has happened

words.tr: n. 方格图案 vt. 使（某物）呈现方格图案或不同颜色或不同深浅的方格
words.ex: The table has a chequer pattern.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个方格图案。
words.en: A pattern of squares, typically of alternating colours; to mark with such a pattern.

words.ex: The smell repels insects.
words.ex_cn: 这种气味能击退昆虫。
words.en: If something repels you, it is so unpleasant or offensive that you want to avoid it or push it away.

words.tr: n. 前进；进展；间隔时间
words.ex: He made headway in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题上取得了进展。
words.en: If you make headway, you progress towards achieving something.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.ex: The critics praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 评论家们称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.ex: The clouds were in the shape of a dragon.
words.ex_cn: prep. 云朵呈龙的形状。
words.en: Having the form or appearance of something.

words.ex: The manager will delegate the task to her assistant.
words.ex_cn: 经理将把这个任务委派给她的助手。
words.en: A delegate is a person who is chosen or elected to vote or make decisions on behalf of a group of people, especially at a conference or a meeting. As a verb, to delegate means to give a task or responsibility to another person, especially someone who is less senior than you.

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.tr: phrase. 代表…说话；要求得到；订购
words.ex: He cannot speak for me.
words.ex_cn: 他不能代表我说话。
words.en: To speak on behalf of someone or something; to represent or defend someone or something in speech.

words.tr: phrase. 证明是有效的，证实
words.ex: The new method will prove out in the long run.
words.ex_cn: v. 新方法最终会证明是有效的。
words.en: To show that something is true or correct by means of argument or evidence.

words.ex: The platypus swims in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鸭嘴兽在河里游泳。
words.en: A platypus is a small aquatic mammal of eastern Australia and Tasmania, having a dense brown fur, webbed feet, and a broad bill resembling that of a duck. It is one of the few mammals that lay eggs.

words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.tr:
n. 吱吱声；尖叫声
v. 短促而尖厉地叫；吱吱叫
words.ex: The mouse makes a small squeak.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠发出一声小小的吱吱声。
words.en: If something or someone squeaks, they make a short, high-pitched sound.

words.ex: Bees pollinate flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给花园里的花授粉。
words.en: To pollinate means to transfer pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part, enabling fertilization and the production of seeds.

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.tr: phrase. 对…负责的；对…承担责任；是…的原因
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: Having an obligation to do something, or having control over or care for someone, as part of one's job or role.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.ex: The police dispersed the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 警察驱散了人群。
words.en: If a crowd of people disperses or is dispersed, it breaks up and the people go in different directions.

words.tr: phrase. 在这一方面；在这一点上；就这一点而言
words.ex: In this respect, the new policy is much better than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 在这方面，新政策比旧政策好得多。
words.en: in this particular aspect or detail

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.ex: The village sent a tribute of grain to the king.
words.ex_cn: 村庄向国王进贡了谷物。
words.en: A tribute is something that you say, do, or make to show your admiration and respect for someone.

words.ex: Computational methods are widely used in scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 计算方法在科学研究中被广泛使用。
words.en: Relating to the use of computers or involving computation.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 母亲的；母性的；母系的；
words.ex: Her maternal love kept the family strong.
words.ex_cn: 她的母爱让家庭保持坚强。
words.en: Maternal feelings or actions are typical of a kind, loving mother.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: The boat travels on the waterway.
words.ex_cn: 船在水道上行驶。
words.en: A waterway is a river, canal, or other route for travel by water.

words.tr: adv. 自相矛盾地；矛盾地；
words.ex: Paradoxically, he is very quiet, but he speaks the most in class.
words.ex_cn: 自相矛盾地，他非常安静，但在课堂上却说得最多。
words.en: In a way that is contrary to expectations or seemingly contradictory.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕某物或某种情况；对……感到恐惧
words.ex: She is scared of spiders.
words.ex_cn: 她害怕蜘蛛。
words.en: To feel fear or anxiety about someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 亲自实践的；亲自动手的
words.ex: He likes hands-on learning in science class.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在科学课上动手学习。
words.en: Involving or offering active participation rather than theory or observation.

words.tr: adj. 纹章学的；传令官的
words.ex: The shield has a heraldic lion on it.
words.ex_cn: 盾牌上有一个纹章狮子。
words.en: Heraldic relates to heraldry or heralds, especially the study or creation of coats of arms and the tracing of genealogies.

words.ex: He makes a decision quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快做出决定。
words.en: To choose between options after consideration; to make up one's mind.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.tr: n. 生态学家；生态学者；
words.ex: The ecologist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生态学家研究了森林里的鸟类。
words.en: An ecologist is a scientist who studies the relationships between living things and their environment.

words.tr: phrase. 失去控制；变得无法管理
words.ex: The fire went out of control quickly.
words.ex_cn: 火势迅速失控了。
words.en: To become unmanageable or to cease to function in a controlled or intended manner.

words.ex: He studies physiology to understand how the human body works.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生理学以了解人体如何运作。
words.en: The branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.

words.ex: The zygote begins to divide and form an embryo.
words.ex_cn: 受精卵开始分裂并形成胚胎。
words.en: A zygote is the initial cell formed when two gamete cells are joined by means of sexual reproduction. In multicellular organisms, it is the earliest developmental stage of the embryo.

words.ex: He hums a tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着曲子。
words.en: To make a low, steady, continuous sound like that of a bee.

words.ex: The snake made a loud hiss.
words.ex_cn: 蛇发出了响亮的嘶嘶声。
words.en: To make a sharp sound like that of the letter s prolonged, as a snake does, or as steam does when forced under pressure through a small opening.

words.tr: adj. 享有声望的；声望很高的；
words.ex: He got into a prestigious university.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了一所享有声望的大学。
words.en: A prestigious institution, job, or activity is respected and admired because it is considered to be of very high quality.

words.ex: The witness lost credibility after lying.
words.ex_cn: 证人因撒谎而失去了可信性。
words.en: The quality of being trusted and believed in.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 一套规则；一系列规定
words.ex: A set of rules helps students know what to do in class.
words.ex_cn: 一套规则帮助学生知道在课堂上该做什么。
words.en: A set of rules refers to a collection of prescribed guidelines or principles that dictate how things should be done or how people should behave in a particular context.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.ex: The delegation met with the president yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 代表团昨天会见了总统。
words.en: A delegation is a group of people who have been sent somewhere to have talks with other people on behalf of a larger group of people.

words.ex: The palace has a grandiose design with tall columns and golden domes.
words.ex_cn: 这座宫殿有着宏伟的设计，配有高大的柱子和金色的圆顶。
words.en: If you describe something as grandiose, you mean it is larger or more elaborate than necessary, or it is intended to seem very impressive or magnificent.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: Behold the beautiful sunset.
words.ex_cn: 看那美丽的日落。
words.en: To see or observe (someone or something, especially something remarkable or impressive).

words.ex: The neuron sends signals to the brain.
words.ex_cn: 神经元向大脑发送信号。
words.en: A neuron is a cell that is specialized to conduct nerve impulses.

words.tr: adj. 人道主义的；慈善的；
words.ex: The humanitarian aid helped the hungry children.
words.ex_cn: 人道主义援助帮助了饥饿的孩子们。
words.en: A humanitarian is someone who is involved in or connected with improving people's lives and reducing suffering.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.tr: adj. 奇迹般的；不可思议的；神奇的
words.ex: The sick boy made a miraculous recovery.
words.ex_cn: 那个生病的男孩奇迹般地康复了。
words.en: If you describe a good event as miraculous, you mean that it is very surprising and unexpected.

words.tr:
v. 缩进排版；使呈锯齿状
n. 订货单
words.ex: Please indent the first line of each paragraph.
words.ex_cn: 请将每段的第一行缩进。
words.en: To start a line of text further from the margin than the main part of the text.

words.tr: n. 流出；消逝；流出物；结束
words.ex: The efflux of water from the pipe was uncontrollable.
words.ex_cn: 从管道流出的水无法控制。
words.en: The flowing out of a substance or particle.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.ex: The parasitic worm lives inside the host.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主体内。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a parasite; living on or in another organism and deriving nutrients at the host's expense.

words.tr: phrase. 与...共事；与...合作； 对...起作用
words.ex: He works with numbers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和数字打交道。
words.en: To collaborate or deal with someone or something in a shared task or activity.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: People all over the world like chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 全世界的人都喜欢巧克力。
words.en: everywhere in the world

words.ex: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: The pollution caused the degradation of the river.
words.ex_cn: 污染导致了河流的恶化。
words.en: The process by which something is reduced in quality, value, or status.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.ex: She has a feminine voice.
words.ex_cn: 她的声音很女性化。
words.en: having qualities or an appearance traditionally associated with women, especially delicacy and prettiness.

words.tr: phrase. 行政长官；董事长；美国总统；（美国的）州长
words.ex: The chief executive made a decision today.
words.ex_cn: 首席执行官今天做了一个决定。
words.en: The chief executive is the person with the highest rank in a company or organization, who is responsible for making decisions and ensuring that the company or organization achieves its goals.

words.tr: v. 安顿；安居；安卧；坐落于
words.ex: The baby nestles close to her mother.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿依偎在妈妈身边。
words.en: To settle or lie comfortably within or against something.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；搬离；逐渐放弃；摆脱
words.ex: He wants to move away from the noisy city.
words.ex_cn: 他想离开这个嘈杂的城市。
words.en: To stop doing or using something, or to change from one thing to another.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.ex: The car is fitted with a new engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车装有新发动机。
words.en: To be equipped or supplied with something.

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.ex: The car's acceleration increased when the driver pressed the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当司机踩油门时，汽车的加速度增加了。
words.en: Acceleration is the rate at which a car or other vehicle can increase its speed, often measured in the time it takes to go from 0 to 60 miles per hour.

words.ex: I misplace my keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都把钥匙弄丢。
words.en: If you misplace something, you lose it, usually only temporarily.

words.ex: I stay in touch with my old friends by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和老朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 关于……的反馈；对……的意见或反应
words.ex: The teacher gave feedback on my homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师对我的作业给出了反馈。
words.en: Comments or opinions given about something, often to help improve it.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.tr: phrase. 一代又一代地；世世代代地
words.ex: The custom has been passed down from generation to generation.
words.ex_cn: 这个习俗世世代代流传下来。
words.en: Passed from parents to children over a long period of time.

words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.ex: He did an in-depth study of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题进行了深入的研究。
words.en: If you do something in depth, you do it very thoroughly and consider all the details.

words.tr: phrase. 与…互动；与…相互作用；与…交流
words.ex: The children interact with each other at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校里互相交流。
words.en: To communicate or engage with someone, often in a social or professional context.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.tr: phrase. 服从；容易遭受；受制于
words.ex: All students are subject to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须服从校规。
words.en: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.

words.tr: adj. 全知的；无所不知的
words.ex: The omniscient narrator knows everything about the characters.
words.ex_cn: 全知的叙述者了解角色的一切。
words.en: Knowing everything; having infinite awareness, understanding, and insight.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: This room can serve as a meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间可以充当会议室。
words.en: To function or be used as something.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.ex: Can you pronounce this word correctly?
words.ex_cn: 你能正确发音这个词吗？
words.en: To pronounce means to make the sound of a word or letter with your voice. It can also mean to declare or announce something officially or formally.

words.tr: adj. 匆匆的；粗略的；仓促的
words.ex: He gave the report a cursory look.
words.ex_cn: 他粗略地看了看这份报告。
words.en: A cursory glance or examination is a quick one that is not very thorough.

words.ex: His physiological response to stress is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 他对压力的生理反应非常强烈。
words.en: Physiological refers to the normal functions of living organisms and their parts, or to the branch of biology that deals with these functions.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；提出诉讼
words.ex: He must take action now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在必须采取行动。
words.en: To do something in order to deal with a situation or problem.

words.ex: He is referred to as a genius by his teachers.
words.ex_cn: 他的老师称他为天才。
words.en: to be called or known by a particular name or title

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.tr:
n. 接缝；缝合处；矿层；煤层
v. 缝合；有裂痕
words.ex: The seam of the shirt came loose.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫的接缝松开了。
words.en: A seam is a line where two pieces of fabric are sewn together in a garment or other article.

words.ex: The cell has a thin membrane.
words.ex_cn: 细胞有一层薄薄的膜。
words.en: A membrane is a thin layer of tissue or material that covers or lines a part of the body, or separates one area from another.

words.ex: The mother used motherese to communicate with her baby.
words.ex_cn: 母亲用妈妈语与她的宝宝交流。
words.en: Motherese refers to the simplified and exaggerated language used by mothers when speaking to their infants.

words.ex: The bridge connects with the other side of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接到河的另一边。
words.en: To establish a relationship or communication with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 针对；以…为目标；瞄准
words.ex: The ad is target at young people.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告针对年轻人。
words.en: To direct something, especially criticism or a product, towards a particular person or group.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.tr: phrase. 具有法律约束力的；在法律上有强制效力的
words.ex: The contract is legally binding.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同具有法律约束力。
words.en: If a contract or agreement is legally binding, it is enforceable by law.

words.tr:
v. 惊异于；惊异；
n. 令人惊异的人（或事）；
words.ex: I marvel at how fast she runs.
words.ex_cn: 我惊异于她跑得有多快。
words.en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: The formula is derived from simple math rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个公式是从简单的数学规则推导出来的。
words.en: If you say that something is derived from something else, you mean that it comes from that thing.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.ex: He unscrewed the bottle cap slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地拧开了瓶盖。
words.en: To loosen or remove something by turning it.

words.tr:
v. 爆裂；突然而起；
n. 爆裂；突然而起；
words.ex: The balloon burst when he blew too much air.
words.ex_cn: 当他吹入太多空气时，气球爆裂了。
words.en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out; used especially to describe the sound of something breaking open.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: They chose arbitration to solve their dispute.
words.ex_cn: 他们选择了仲裁来解决他们的纠纷。
words.en: Arbitration is a process in which a disagreement between two people or groups is settled by an arbitrator.

words.ex: He is late at times.
words.ex_cn: 他有时会迟到。
words.en: on some occasions; occasionally

words.ex: We optimize the route to save time.
words.ex_cn: 我们优化路线以节省时间。
words.en: To optimize something means to make it as good or as effective as possible.

words.ex: The vastness of the ocean is both humbling and awe-inspiring.
words.ex_cn: 海洋的浩瀚既令人敬畏又令人赞叹。
words.en: The quality of being very large or immense.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: The mistreatment of animals in circuses is a growing concern.
words.ex_cn: 马戏团中动物的虐待问题日益引起关注。
words.en: The act of treating someone or something badly, cruelly, or unfairly.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.ex: The gravitational force pulls the apple to the ground.
words.ex_cn: 引力把苹果拉向地面。
words.en: relating to or resulting from the force of gravity

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.ex: A handful of students stayed after class to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 少数学生课后留下来提问。
words.en: A handful of something is a small amount of it, especially when it is not enough or when it is difficult to manage.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: The coach endorses the new player.
words.ex_cn: 教练支持这位新球员。
words.en: If you endorse someone or something, you say publicly that you support or approve of them.

words.tr: phrase. 经过；通过；经历；经历并完成
words.ex: We pass through the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上都穿过公园。
words.en: To move or travel through a place or area.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；令人震惊的； v. “stun”的现在分词；
words.ex: She wore a stunning dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件极好的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Extremely impressive or attractive.

words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.ex: The village suffered from famine last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄遭受了饥荒。
words.en: A famine is a serious shortage of food in a country, which may cause many people to get sick or die.

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.ex: He has an aversion to spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他厌恶辛辣食物。
words.en: A strong dislike or disinclination towards someone or something.

words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他的钥匙。
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.ex: He resisted the temptation to eat cake.
words.ex_cn: 他抵制了吃蛋糕的诱惑。
words.en: If you feel you want to do something or have something, even though you know you really should avoid it, you can refer to this feeling as temptation.

words.ex: The snail moves slowly across the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过花园。
words.en: A snail is a small creature with a soft, wet body and a spiral shell. It moves very slowly.

words.ex: The rain deepened the puddles on the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水加深了路上的水坑。
words.en: If a situation or emotion deepens or if something deepens it, it becomes stronger and more intense.

words.ex: The electrode conducts electricity in the battery.
words.ex_cn: 电极在电池中传导电流。
words.en: An electrode is a conductor through which electricity enters or leaves an object, substance, or region.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.ex: She is pursuing a degree in musicology.
words.ex_cn: 她正在攻读音乐学学位。
words.en: The scholarly study of music, including its history, theory, and cultural context.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: He did the transcription of the meeting notes by hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手抄了会议记录。
words.en: The process of transcribing something, or a written or printed representation of this.

words.ex: He made a painstaking effort to fix the small details.
words.ex_cn: 他细心地努力修正每一个小细节。
words.en: If you describe someone's work as painstaking, you mean that they do it very carefully and thoroughly, often taking a long time.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.ex: He scooped soup with a spoon.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子舀汤。
words.en: A scoop is a tool like a large spoon which is used for picking up substances such as ice cream or an amount of a substance that is held in a scoop. It can also refer to an important or exciting news story that is reported in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast before anyone else reports it.

words.ex: Please act as a guide for the visitors.
words.ex_cn: 请为来访者充当向导。
words.en: To function or serve in a particular role or capacity.

words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: He is curious about how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他对植物如何生长感到好奇。
words.en: To have a strong desire to learn or know about something.

words.ex: The game simulates real traffic conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏模拟了真实的交通状况。
words.en: To simulate is to create a model or representation of a situation, process, or system for the purpose of study, analysis, or training. It involves imitating the conditions of a real event or environment to understand its effects or to practice responses to it.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr:
n. 摘录；摘要
v. 摘录；引用
words.ex: He read an excerpt from the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的一段摘录。
words.en: An excerpt is a short piece of writing or music which is taken from a larger piece.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.ex: We had a teleconference with the team in Japan.
words.ex_cn: 我们与日本的团队进行了电话会议。
words.en: A teleconference is a meeting that is held using a telephone or video system, allowing people in different places to participate.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: We tuck into our breakfast at 7 a.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上7点开始吃早餐。
words.en: To start eating something with enthusiasm.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: To devastate means to destroy or ruin something completely, or to cause someone to feel extreme sadness or shock.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；例证；例示
words.ex: This example exemplifies the rule clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子清楚地说明了这条规则。
words.en: To exemplify means to be a typical example of something or to give an example of something.

words.ex: The nucleus of the team is the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的核心是队长。
words.en: The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group, forming the basis for its activity and growth.

words.ex: The child found a mollusc on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在海滩上发现了一只软体动物。
words.en: A mollusc is an invertebrate of a large phylum which includes snails, slugs, mussels, and octopuses. They have a soft unsegmented body and live in aquatic or damp habitats, and most kinds have an external calcareous shell.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: The depth of the ocean is unfathomable.
words.ex_cn: 海洋的深度是深不可测的。
words.en: If something is unfathomable, it is so mysterious or complicated that it is impossible to understand or explain.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr:
n. 海狸；海狸毛皮
v. 勤奋工作
words.ex: The beaver builds a dam with sticks and mud.
words.ex_cn: 海狸用树枝和泥土筑坝。
words.en: A beaver is a large rodent with a broad, flat tail, known for building dams and lodges in rivers.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是木头做的。
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖舒适的；紧密的；紧身的；贴身的
n. 酒馆内的雅间
words.ex: The cottage was snug and warm, perfect for a winter retreat.
words.ex_cn: 这间小屋舒适温暖，是冬季度假的完美之地。
words.en: If you feel snug or are in a snug place, you are very warm and comfortable, especially because you are protected from cold or danger.

words.ex: Clean water is a boon to the village.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水对这个村庄是有益的。
words.en: A boon is something that is very helpful and improves the quality of life.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr: n. 导管；管道；水管；水道
words.ex: The cable is a conduit for electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这根电缆是电的通道。
words.en: A conduit is a channel or pipe for conveying water or other fluid.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: The region is known for its malarial swamps.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区以其疟疾肆虐的沼泽而闻名。
words.en: Relating to or affected by malaria.

words.tr: n. 存户；存款人；寄托者
words.ex: The bank has a large number of depositors.
words.ex_cn: 这家银行有大量的存款人。
words.en: A depositor is a person or entity that places money in a bank account or similar financial institution.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.ex: She wants to be a part of the team.
words.ex_cn: 她想成为团队的一部分。
words.en: To be included or involved in something.

words.ex: My grandfather passed down his old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父把他的旧手表传给了我。
words.en: To transmit or hand down from one generation to another.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.tr: n. 思维模式；心态；观念框架
words.ex: He has a positive mind-set about learning.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习有积极的心态。
words.en: A person's way of thinking or their attitude towards something.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The sensory experience of eating chocolate is wonderful.
words.ex_cn: 吃巧克力的感觉体验很棒。
words.en: Sensory means relating to the physical senses of touch, smell, taste, hearing, and sight.

words.ex: The concept of omniscience is often attributed to deities.
words.ex_cn: 全知的概念常常被归因于神灵。
words.en: The state of knowing everything.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点起床。
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: The continuity of the story made it easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的连续性让它容易理解。
words.en: Continuity is the fact that something continues to happen or exist, with no great changes or interruptions.

words.ex: The next generation of smartphones will have even more advanced features.
words.ex_cn: 下一代的智能手机将会有更先进的功能。
words.en: The next generation refers to the group of people who are born and live after the current generation, often implying future developments or innovations.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.ex: The two teams decide to unite for the competition.
words.ex_cn: 这两个队伍决定在比赛中联合起来。
words.en: If a group of people or things unite or if someone unites them, they join together and act as a group.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人提供某物；为某人供给某物
words.ex: He provides his sister with books.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妹妹提供书籍。
words.en: To supply or give something to a person.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: The school changed its curricula last year.
words.ex_cn: 学校去年更改了课程。
words.en: Curricula are the subjects that are taught by a school, college, or university, or the things that are studied in a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 甲壳动物
adj. 甲壳类的
words.ex: The crab is a crustacean.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹是一种甲壳类动物。
words.en: A crustacean is a type of animal with a hard shell, such as a crab or lobster.

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.ex: His tall height is hereditary from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他高高的身材是遗传自父母的。
words.en: A hereditary characteristic or illness is passed from the genes of a parent to a child.

words.tr: phrase. 受…约束的；受…限制的
words.ex_cn: 他受游戏规则的约束。
words.en: To be compelled or required to act in a certain way by a rule, law, or agreement.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；（动物）觅食；
n. 饲料；草料；
words.ex: The bear forages for berries in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊在森林里搜寻浆果。
words.en: If you forage, you search for food or other supplies. Forage can also refer to food for animals, especially when it is grown or collected.

words.tr: phrase. 完成；解决；逐渐穿过；穿透
words.ex: He worked through all the math problems before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了所有的数学题。
words.en: To deal with or solve a problem or task completely or thoroughly.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.tr: 实体模型; 假雷达;  制造模型;  制造样机
words.ex: He made a mockup of the new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个新手机的模型。
words.en: A full-scale model of an object or system, used for testing, demonstration, or design purposes.

words.ex: We learn about animals in science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在科学课上了解动物。
words.en: To gain knowledge or information about a particular subject or topic.

words.tr: n. 繁殖；饲养； v. “breed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The farm focuses on cattle breeding.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场专注于牛的繁殖。
words.en: The process of producing animals or plants by sexual reproduction, or the process of raising animals or plants in controlled conditions.

words.tr: n. 运转; 运行; 活动方式; （已开采过的）矿坑
words.ex: The workings of the machine were clearly visible.
words.ex_cn: 机器的运转情况清晰可见。
words.en: The workings of something are the parts of it which allow it to function or operate.
